ZEBOIM RAPID TRANSIT
MASS DRIVER SERVICE LINE<New>Elly
"This subway was built with
the facility. The access
tunnels should lead inside."<New>Emeralda
"Emeralda remembers these
walls. They are Zeboim."<Close>

Elly
"The transit grid still has
power. The service line runs
beneath this corridor."<Close>

Emeralda
"Old Zeboim place...
but it is still awake."<Close>

Elly
"The launch control is
at the far end. Stay
close, Emeralda."<Close>

Emeralda
"Emeralda stays with Elly.
We find the way."<Close>
